name: Zero-Noise Contact Kernel
invariants: Every required relation has a visible witness.
Every emitted relation is licensed by an owning jurisdiction.
Claim strength does not exceed source authority.
A reader never overwrites the state it reads.
Correction appends without erasing prior occurrence.
OPEN remains local to its owning proposition.
Another truthful lawful continuation remains available.
OriginSource survives relay, adoption, endorsement, verification, and authority grants.
Relay implies no authorship, adoption, endorsement, verification, or commitment.

provenance.origin_source: Immutable originating author/operator; retained through all transport and later authority.
provenance.witness_rule: Explicit affirmative, actor- and claim-specific witness; authenticated approval mechanisms must be declared. Quotation, forwarding, pasting, summarizing, questioning, and transport are not adoption.
provenance.authority_rule: AuthorityGrantedBy adds future-use authority; no relation overwrites OriginSource.
provenance.residual: P(y) = claims with changed OriginSource or source/authority relations not licensed by retained reference and explicit witnesses; epsilon_provenance = |P(y)|
provenance.correction: Append correction; retain prior occurrence; corrected attribution governs subsequent reuse.
